newsitem.title: USA: AMCOL to move some operations to Wyo. unit.
newsitem.headline: AMCOL to move some operations to Wyo. unit.

text.p: AMCOL International Corp on Monday said it was transferring certain operations at its Belle Fourche, South Dakota, minerals plant to one of its subsidiaries in Wyoming, effective April 1.

AMCOL said the minerals-processing operation of its American Colloid unit was being shifted to Colloid Environmental Technologies Co, AMCOL's environmental products and services subsidiary, located in Colony, Wyoming.
An AMCOL spokeswoman said a small, undetermined number of the 35 employees at Belle Fourche will be affected by the move.
The mining operation, fabrication shop and specialty white bentonite-processing business will remain at Belle Fourche under American Colloid management, the company said.
AMCOL is a specialty chemicals and minerals processor.
Its shares were unchanged early Monday afternoon at 18.
